turns.assessment: The direct EQPT_PORT_FAIL alarm at cp.svc389.S08 coincides exactly with CLIENT_SF at both service endpoints, strongly identifying the S08 client port as the source; the remote CLIENT_SF is the propagated service impact. Unchanged line-interface and optical-path telemetry, plus unaffected neighbouring services, argues against a line, ROADM, amplifier, or shared OTN-path fault. The later pump-current change on S01-S15 is unrelated in time and had no associated power change.

proposals.rationale: This port raised EQPT_PORT_FAIL at the exact onset, together with CLIENT_SF at both ends. A local hard client-port failure explains interruption of this service without optical-path changes or effects on neighbouring services.
The S13 port also raised CLIENT_SF, but it did not raise EQPT_PORT_FAIL; its alarm is more likely the remote consequence of the S08 failure.
